message.content: {"note_claim": "William Barr held the position of US Attorney General in July 2019 (so the FBI report calling him 'current United States Attorney General' is consistent with 2019, not 1994).", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Barr became attorney general for the second time in 2019.", "reason": "The page shows Barr served as AG from February 14, 2019 to December 23, 2020, covering July 2019, and that his earlier term ended in 1993, so he was not AG in 1994."}

parsed.note_claim: William Barr held the position of US Attorney General in July 2019 (so the FBI report calling him 'current United States Attorney General' is consistent with 2019, not 1994).
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Barr became attorney general for the second time in 2019.
parsed.reason: The page shows Barr served as AG from February 14, 2019 to December 23, 2020, covering July 2019, and that his earlier term ended in 1993, so he was not AG in 1994.
